title: CLI session authorization response
description: When replaying a completed CLI session, the provider MUST require the same verified issuer and subject that originally authorized the session, then return key_id only after row-locking an active, unrevoked, unexpired API key owned by the same authenticated organization whose persisted scopes remain a non-empty unique subset of the current allowlist; missing or mismatched authorizing identity, cross-tenant, malformed, empty, duplicate, retired-scope, revoked, or expired key references MUST fail closed. API-key expiry MUST be evaluated after the referenced key row lock is acquired, using a non-transaction-start persistence wall clock in the same serializable transaction; transaction-start timestamps and service-process clock comparisons are forbidden.
